question.text:
Paragraph: The reaction of compound $\mathbf{P}$ with $\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr}$ (excess) in $\left(\mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{H}_{5}\right)_{2} \mathrm{O}$ followed by addition of $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ gives $\mathbf{Q}$. The compound $\mathbf{Q}$ on treatment with $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$ at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ gives $\mathbf{R}$. The reaction of $\mathbf{R}$ with $\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{COCl}$ in the presence of anhydrous $\mathrm{AlCl}_{3}$ in $\mathrm{CH}_{2} \mathrm{Cl}_{2}$ followed by treatment with $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ produces compound $\mathbf{S}$. [Et in compound $\mathbf{P}$ is ethyl group]

Question: The reactions, $\mathbf{Q}$ to $\mathbf{R}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ to $\mathbf{S}$, are

options.text: Friedel-Crafts alkylation, dehydration, and Friedel-Crafts acylation

solution.text: The reaction of an ester (other than format) with Grignard’s reagent followed by hydrolysis in acidic medium produces a tertiary alcohol. The dehydration of 3 o -alcohol at O o C in the given compound produces an alkyl group in the benzene ring. This compound on reaction with CH 3 COCl 2 in CH 2 Cl 2 and shows Friedel craft's alkylation reaction
